BREAKING: JPMorgan has raised its SpaceX price target from $225 to $240 following the company's latest earnings, while maintaining its Overweight rating. 

• Price target increased from $225 to $240.
• Overweight rating reaffirmed.
• With SpaceX trading near $117, the new target is more than double the current share price.

The updated outlook reflects JPMorgan's continued confidence in SpaceX's long-term growth following its latest earnings report.
